description: Every startup blocker observed on the OH board, one entry per app and blocker, across corpora. 'row' is the gap-map row id that names the gap when one exists; null means no row modelled it (a coverage gap). 'fixed_in' is the Westlake commit that closed it, if any. gap-map --ledger marks rows that have blocked an app before.
